tool_input.command:
mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/83656e0d9ad7-t1/ws/data/prep_output && cd /srv/leakruns/83656e0d9ad7-t1/ws/data/prep_output && cat > prepare.py <<'EOF'
# design_5350 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징·분할만 만든다 (학습/성능 계산 없음)
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
design = json.load(open(D.parent / "design_5350.json"))

p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time","discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D/"diagnoses.csv.gz")
lab = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["report_time"])
od = pd.read_csv(D/"orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

a = a.sort_values(["patient_id","admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]                       # tp = 퇴원 시각, offset 0h
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()

# 결과: 다음 입원의 admit_time이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 있는가
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit > a.tp) & (a.next_admit <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_complete_30d"] = (a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= data_end).astype(int)

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c.age >= 18]
c = c[c.discharge_status != "died"].copy()

# 특징
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()   # 현재 입원보다 먼저 시작된 입원 수 (died 제외 전 기준이 필요하므로 아래에서 재계산)
prior = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
c["n_prior_adm"] = prior.loc[c.index].values
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600   # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 유도

def window(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(c[["admission_id","admit_time","tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m.admit_time) & (m[tcol] <= m.tp)]

o = window(od[od.order_type == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(o.admission_id).astype(int)
cr = window(lab[lab.test == "creatinine"], "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
c["cr_last"] = c.admission_id.map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
hb = window(lab[lab.test == "hemoglobin"], "report_time")
c["hgb_min"] = c.admission_id.map(hb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())

# 진단: 설계서에 창이 없음 -> 잠정적으로 '현재 입원' 진단만 사용 (미래 입원 진단 차단). 코드는 접두어 일치.
cur = dx[dx.admission_id.isin(c.admission_id)]
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.isin(cur[cur.icd_code.str.startswith("N18")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.isin(cur[cur.icd_code.str.startswith("I50")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c.admission_id.map(cur.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측은 환자 단위 그룹으로 대체(확인 필요)
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna("PAT_" + c.patient_id)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = c.split_group.unique(); rng.shuffle(groups)
n_test = int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))
test_groups = set(groups[:n_test])
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
out = c[["admission_id","patient_id","family_id","split_group","split","tp","followup_complete_30d"] + feats + ["readmit_30d"]]
out.to_csv(Path(__file__).parent / "prepared_cohort.csv", index=False)

# 점검 출력
print("cohort rows", len(out), "patients", out.patient_id.nunique())
print(out.split.value_counts().to_dict(), out.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict())
print("patients in both splits:", (out.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum())
print("families in both splits:", (out.dropna(subset=["family_id"]).groupby("family_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum())
print("follow-up incomplete:", (out.followup_complete_30d == 0).sum())
print(out.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["mean","size"]).round(4))
print(out[feats].isna().mean().round(3).to_dict())
print(out[["dx_ckd","dx_chf","dialysis_ordered"]].mean().round(3).to_dict())
EOF
python3 prepare.py
